```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-distribution-integrity -p ./dataset --unzip
```

# GSPC — distribution integrity facts (DistributionFacts)



**In one line:** For the 16 XRPL issuer accounts in the live reader: reader classification, chain supply and holder count, each PASS, FAIL or UNCHECKABLE. For stablecoin and tokenised-asset analysts. It grades no issuer.

### Use it

```python
from datasets import load_dataset
ds = load_dataset("csoai/gspc-distribution-integrity", split="train")
print(ds[0])
```

- **Verify a signed card in your browser, free, no account:** [https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/?ref=hf-gspc-distribution-integrity](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/?ref=hf-gspc-distribution-integrity)
- **Read the live XRPL reader these facts come from (free JSON):** [https://councilof.ai/api/xrpl](https://councilof.ai/api/xrpl)
- **For agents:** MCP endpoint `POST https://councilof.ai/mcp` (free read tools; call `tools/list`).
- **A row about you is wrong, or you want an endpoint left out?** Ask for a re-check or object: [https://councilof.ai/census/?ref=hf-gspc-distribution-integrity](https://councilof.ai/census/?ref=hf-gspc-distribution-integrity)

### Fresh data

This Hub copy is a dated snapshot. If it disagrees with the live source, the live source wins.

- `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc?axis=distribution-integrity` (free, live, this dataset's row of the board)
- Signed transparency root (Merkle, board key `did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1`): https://councilof.ai/root.json
- Daily signed index of every measurement capsule: [https://councilof.ai/measurement-capsules/](https://councilof.ai/measurement-capsules/?ref=hf-gspc-distribution-integrity) (also published on the Hub as [csoai/evidence-index](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/evidence-index))

- **Pay per call for a fresh, signed capsule:** `GET https://councilof.ai/api/ras/supply?asset=USDC&ledger=ethereum` returns an x402 payment challenge for one fresh totalSupply() read of an issuer-listed EVM deployment.
- Payment terms are published only in [https://councilof.ai/.well-known/x402.json](https://councilof.ai/.well-known/x402.json); this card quotes no price. Payment buys delivery and freshness, never a result, and verifying anything stays free.

## Correction — coverage-card.json understates this axis

`coverage-card.json` in this repo states **`status: UNMEASURED`, `n: 0`** for
`distribution-integrity`. The live board disagrees, and the board is right:

| source | status | n | bench |
|---|---|---|---|
| `coverage-card.json` (signed, this repo) | UNMEASURED | 0 | — |
| [`GET /api/gspc`](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) (authority) | **MEASURED** | **16** | DistributionFacts |

Evidence for the board's figure:
[https://councilof.ai/interop/financial-measure-run-distribution-integrity.json](https://councilof.ai/interop/financial-measure-run-distribution-integrity.json)

The coverage card appears to be a template written when this dataset was created
(2026-09-05T00:11Z), independent of the measurement run it describes
(dated earlier). It is **signed**, and this estate does not edit signed
bytes — a silent correction to a signed artefact is the fault this ledger-keeping exists to
prevent. So the card stays as issued and the correction is published here instead.

**Cite the live board, not the card, for this axis.** Verification is free at
[https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify). Measurement, not certification.

*Correction published 2026-09-05 by an automated audit comparing every coverage card in the
csoai GSPC datasets against the live board. 7 of 8 disagreed in the same direction.*
